# A universal service envelope for the completed two check rule

Principal construction, 16 October 2026. Status: internally derived conditional extension. The ticket invariant, certificate and fixed guard steps survived targeted adversarial checks; the complete principal deduction and global interfaces are in PRINCIPAL_PAIR_THEOREM.md. External correctness and priority remain unestablished. The initial pending version is preserved in history/. The intended two check geometry has Pastawski, Clemente and Cirac as an antecedent, with the Pauli-label caveat recorded in the principal theorem. This construction supplies a location and clock only envelope for its physical pair clocks; a syndrome dependent virtual clock coupling alone would not establish that property.

## Generator and the required stronger quantifier

For each vertex v and pair a={i,j} of its four positive directions, set Pi_(v,a) to the product of the two violated outgoing edge check projectors, Q_(v,a) to the Pauli flip on their positive plaquette, and

    C_(v,a)(rho) = Q_(v,a) Pi_(v,a) rho Pi_(v,a) Q_(v,a) dagger
                   + (I-Pi_(v,a)) rho (I-Pi_(v,a)).          (1)

This channel has 11 qubit support. Use the static generator kappa sum_(v,a,sector)(C_(v,a)-Id). It has six independent rate kappa physical pair proposal clocks per vertex per sector, 12 L^4 channel streams in total. There are two Kraus dissipators per channel, hence 24 L^4 jump terms. The original two check generator has only the active dissipator per pair, 12 L^4 terms, and differs on syndrome coherences. The original whole vertex sweep has 14 L^4 active jumps; its aggregated inactive completion has 16 L^4 dissipators. These are distinct resource counts.

We need one event in physical clock and fault location space that corrects every supported Pauli history. A coupling which chooses a virtual base action from the actual outgoing syndrome establishes a classical law but does not give this quantifier across coherent branches sharing a physical clock schedule. The envelope below uses only the actual six pair clocks.

Reviewed exact source SHA-256 `d837200b12c7c2f4b725e0a850dbb7aa5033c14cfa6e55a9d188c94bd241fb09`. No acquired program was executed. This review covers the local universal domination and certificate-service argument, not the imported global percolation/decoder results or priority.

I found no counterexample to the local claim. The simultaneous Pauli-history domination survives the reset, retained coupon mask, separate CSS-clock, monotonicity, and independent-certificate challenges, under the stated cycle-syndrome geometry, fault-boundary coverage, independent physical Poisson streams, and a fault-free guarded finite height region for clearance certificates. Below is an explicit proof of the potentially delicate parts. This is stronger evidence than the bounded checks, but not a verification of the final diamond-norm theorem.

## 1. Exact reset-epoch invariant

Fix one sector and a vertex v. Partition its evolution into intervals between full resets to `(2,Omega)`. Within such an interval every actual incoming edge at v is constant, and the set of actual outgoing edges can only decrease through v's own legal pair actions.

Indeed a fault capable of changing an incident edge resets v by the stipulated boundary box. Any correction changing an incident edge at v, other than one centered at v, has v as a side or far corner. Immediately before a legal correction at w, the two outgoing checked edges make w and both side vertices incident. The inductive support invariant makes all three ticket states positive. The conservative three-source rule therefore resets both sides and the far corner. This is true whether the changed edge is added or removed. Thus no noncentral actual incident-edge change can occur inside a reset epoch.

If a reset epoch contains a progress tick, all envelope predecessors at that tick are zero. By support domination there are no actual incoming edges then. 16 October 2026. Independent analytic reconstruction from the preserved source packet at the pin recorded in `SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`. This is a receiving investigation, not an integration update. No canonical source or pinned checkout was changed.

## 1. Three generators must remain distinct

On the periodic cubical four-torus there are `6L^4` plaquette qubits and six encoded qubits. In one CSS sector a pair corrector at `v` tests two commuting outgoing edge stabilizers `S_(v,i),S_(v,j)` and writes their positive plaquette Pauli `Q`. Set `Pi=(I-S_i)(I-S_j)/4`. The write anticommutes with both tested checks.

1. **Original active pair:** `kappa sum D[Q Pi]`, with `12L^4` active correction dissipators across both sectors. Its supplied theorem has continual independent single-face Pauli noise. The syndrome-dependent virtual base/extra clock construction applies to that classical Pauli law.
